purpose: Resolve spatial layout, layer quality, local actor binding, semantic utility and temporal recovery from the existing cache; preserve findings and retire cloud/local bulk features.

spend.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
spend.runtime_admission: Benchmark real pipeline categories, estimate all mandatory jobs plus nine shortlisted jobs, add 30 percent and 20-minute export reserve. Refuse bulk work if the complete matrix exceeds remaining budget.

scope.label_status: Existing exploratory pseudo/AI-reviewed labels; unknown pixels ignored; no fresh independent confirmation claims.
scope.source_holdout: Four breadth clips are held out individually; shared venue and prior use limit generalization. Armbar splits are reused exploratory development.
scope.identities: Frame-zero reference supervision is explicitly assisted; reference frames excluded from scored outputs. Canonical semantic mapping follows saved actor audit.

work_packages.name: Layer and readout screen
required: 27 breadth pooled layers with spatial-layout caveat

work_packages.name: Temporal ownership
required: no future-conditioned semantic states in causal tests

advancement_gates.semantic: Real queries must improve local ownership over matched nonsemantic controls; equivariance/sensitivity alone cannot pass.
advancement_gates.interpretation: Exploratory thresholds, not claims of independent accuracy; a complete negative campaign is success.

selection: Layer and hyperparameter selection uses development/training folds only. Do not select seeds or change prompts/labels after outputs. Test all mandatory packages; do not keep trying until a gate passes.
retirement: After compact archive verification, delete the exact authorized network volume and downloaded Qwen layers; preserve original media, labels, experiment records, decoder checkpoints and unrelated caches. No indefinite retention.
